title: Expression-level concordance and implementation sensitivity of ligand–receptor priority rankings in mouse cerebral ischemia
description: Code, complete cached results, figure inputs, source audits and observed environment locks for a cross-cohort reproducibility case study in mouse cerebral ischemia. The study attributes the shared-score ranking correction to upstream LIANA PR #261 (merge d4211373692e7b9c10210488ccb1efe06452b097). Native LIANA 1.10.0 inference and fixed-commit aggregation-only replay are distinct scopes; a complete newer-version pipeline is not claimed. Raw GEO and corrected cell matrices are separate assets. The preserved v2 analysis snapshot and new environment records are explicitly versioned.
